pages.text: $(bold)Mikoshi Kago$(): like slipping into a cocoon, unmoved as a mountain. $(br2)$(bold)Trigger$(): passively activates while wrapped inside another's Domain (the Cursed Core must have this skill installed; occupies a skill slot). $(br2)$(bold)Effect$(): the caster comes to a complete standstill — self-paralysis: no techniques, no items, no movement; in exchange you gain absolute resistance to Domain effects: the paralysis of Unlimited Void, the slashes of Malevolent Shrine, and the like are all rendered void.

$(bold)Upkeep$(): drains Cursed Energy continuously at 24 per second; when it runs dry the skill fails automatically and Domain effects land on you as usual. $(br2)$(bold)Use$(): the last card to play when a powerful enemy's Domain has you cornered — trade movement for survival while waiting for an ally's support or the foe's Cursed Energy to run dry; leaving the Domain's range dispels it automatically.
